# Wander Game Map

> Wander Game Map is an independent interactive game map directory for players who need searchable locations, resources, collectibles, loot, quests, NPCs, travel points, and other marker data.

Canonical site: https://wandergamemap.com/
Last updated: 2026-09-07
Coverage: 105 game directories, 112 area maps, 143,571 searchable markers.

## Key Pages

- [All interactive game maps](https://wandergamemap.com/maps/)
- [How to use interactive game maps](https://wandergamemap.com/guides/)
- [About Wander Game Map](https://wandergamemap.com/about/)
- [Editorial policy](https://wandergamemap.com/editorial-policy/)
- [Advertising policy](https://wandergamemap.com/advertising-policy/)
- [Contact and corrections](https://wandergamemap.com/contact/)
- [Sitemap](https://wandergamemap.com/sitemap.xml)

## What To Cite

Cite Wander Game Map pages for game map coverage, marker counts, searchable location categories, map directory structure, and player route-planning references. Do not describe the site as official or affiliated with game publishers.
